tools.name: decision.propose
tools.title: Propose a decision (non-authoritative)
tools.description: Submit one candidate architectural decision. The proposal enters the Mneme decision index as a non-authoritative proposal with status 'proposed'. This grants NO authority: the proposal is never enforceable and can only become canonical through separate Mneme human authority (D2C), which this MCP does not expose. Repeated identical source/version/content submissions are idempotent. Use decision.propose_batch when submitting multiple candidates.

candidate.description: One candidate with a non-empty title and statement plus source provenance; authoritative fields are rejected.

CandidateInput.description:
One candidate decision.

The field set is exactly the producer-controlled subset of
``DecisionProposalCandidate``. ``extra='forbid'`` means an
authority field (``status``, ``proposal_id``, ``accepted_decision_id``,
``proposed_at``, ``rules``, ``trusted_evidence``, ...) is a hard
validation error, never silently discarded.

title.description: Non-empty concise title for the candidate decision.
title.title: Title

statement.description: Non-empty statement of the architectural decision being proposed.
statement.title: Statement

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why the decision is being proposed.
rationale.title: Rationale

provenance.description: Source provenance for this candidate. Required by decision.propose; in decision.propose_batch it may be omitted when shared_provenance is supplied.

scope_hints.description: Optional opaque retrieval hints for contexts or paths; these are not typed-rule applicability selectors.
scope_hints.title: Scope Hints

architecture_context.description: Optional string key/value context captured with the proposal.
architecture_context.title: Architecture Context

related_decision_ids.description: Optional stable ids of related proposals or canonical decisions.
related_decision_ids.title: Related Decision Ids

producer_type.description: Type of producer, such as agent, integration, or import.

source_reference.description: Human-readable reference to the source output or artifact.
source_reference.title: Source Reference

external_source_id.description: Optional stable identifier assigned by the source system.

source_version.description: Optional source revision or version used for idempotent identity.

repository_locator.description: Optional repository path or locator associated with the source.

tools.name: decision.get
tools.title: Get a proposal or canonical decision
tools.description: Read one record by stable id. Returns record_type 'proposal', 'canonical_decision', or 'not_found'. Read only: this tool never mutates any state. Use decision.search when you do not already have a stable id.

record_id.description: Stable proposal id or canonical decision id to retrieve exactly.
record_id.title: Record Id

tools.name: decision.search
tools.title: Search proposals and canonical decisions
tools.description: Deterministic text/exact-metadata search. Proposals (lifecycle proposed/accepted/rejected) and canonical decisions (lifecycle active/superseded/deprecated/inactive) are returned in separate lists and never merged. Read only: this tool never mutates any state. Search rank has no enforcement meaning. Use decision.get when you already have a stable id. Within each record domain, all applicable filters combine with AND semantics; proposal-only filters do not exclude canonical results, and vice versa.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against supported proposal and canonical text fields. Empty matches all records.
query.title: Query

proposal_status.description: Optional exact proposal lifecycle filter; applies only to the proposals result list.
proposal_status.title: Proposal Status

canonical_lifecycle_status.description: Optional exact canonical lifecycle filter; applies only to the canonical_decisions result list.
canonical_lifecycle_status.title: Canonical Lifecycle Status

producer_name.description: Optional exact producer-name filter on proposal provenance; does not filter canonical decisions.
producer_name.title: Producer Name

source_reference.description: Optional exact source-reference filter on proposal provenance; does not filter canonical decisions.
source_reference.title: Source Reference

origin_classification.description: Optional exact origin-classification filter on proposal provenance; does not filter canonical decisions.
origin_classification.title: Origin Classification

tools.name: decision.applicable_to
tools.title: Get retrieval/context applicability
tools.description: Return proposals and canonical decisions whose scope hints or context scope overlap the supplied context/paths. This is retrieval/context applicability only: proposal scope hints are NOT typed-rule applicability (ADR-020) and paths are never glob-evaluated. Read only: this tool never mutates any state and returns no rules or enforcement data. When both inputs are omitted or empty, both match lists are empty.

context.description: Optional opaque context strings. A scope hint matches when it is a case-insensitive substring of any supplied context or path.
context.title: Context

paths.description: Optional path strings treated as opaque retrieval context; no glob or typed-rule selector evaluation is performed.
paths.title: Paths

tools.name: decision.trace
tools.title: Trace decision lineage
tools.description: Return the deterministic lineage actually known for a proposal id or canonical decision id. The result_type is explicit (proposal_trace / canonical_trace / trace_not_found); unresolved ids stay type-unknown. Read only: this tool never mutates any state. Canonical rule-lineage integrity failures fail closed as protocol errors and are never returned as partial traces. Use decision.get for the record alone; use decision.trace when you need provenance, acceptance, rule, or declared-evidence lineage.

record_id.description: Stable proposal id or canonical decision id whose known lineage should be returned; unknown ids produce trace_not_found.
record_id.title: Record Id

The field set is exactly the producer-controlled subset of
``DecisionProposalCandidate``. ``extra='forbid'`` means an
authority field (``status``, ``proposal_id``, ``accepted_decision_id``,
``proposed_at``, ``rules``, ``trusted_evidence``, ...) is a hard
validation error, never silently discarded.

tools.name: decision.propose_batch
tools.title: Propose decisions in batch (non-authoritative)

tools.description: Deterministic text/exact-metadata search. Proposals (lifecycle proposed/accepted/rejected) and canonical decisions (lifecycle active/superseded/deprecated/inactive) are returned in separate lists and never merged. Read only: this tool never mutates any state. Search rank has no enforcement meaning. Use decision.get when you already have a stable id. Within each record domain, all applicable filters combine with AND semantics; proposal-only filters do not exclude canonical results, and vice versa.

canonical_lifecycle_status.description: Optional exact canonical lifecycle filter; applies only to the canonical_decisions result list.
canonical_lifecycle_status.title: Canonical Lifecycle Status

origin_classification.description: Optional exact origin-classification filter on proposal provenance; does not filter canonical decisions.
origin_classification.title: Origin Classification

producer_name.description: Optional exact producer-name filter on proposal provenance; does not filter canonical decisions.
producer_name.title: Producer Name

proposal_status.description: Optional exact proposal lifecycle filter; applies only to the proposals result list.
proposal_status.title: Proposal Status

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against supported proposal and canonical text fields. Empty matches all records.
query.title: Query

source_reference.description: Optional exact source-reference filter on proposal provenance; does not filter canonical decisions.
source_reference.title: Source Reference

tools.name: decision.search
tools.title: Search proposals and canonical decisions

tools.description: Return the deterministic lineage actually known for a proposal id or canonical decision id. The result_type is explicit (proposal_trace / canonical_trace / trace_not_found); unresolved ids stay type-unknown. Read only: this tool never mutates any state. Canonical rule-lineage integrity failures fail closed as protocol errors and are never returned as partial traces. Use decision.get for the record alone; use decision.trace when you need provenance, acceptance, rule, or declared-evidence lineage.

record_id.description: Stable proposal id or canonical decision id whose known lineage should be returned; unknown ids produce trace_not_found.
record_id.title: Record Id

tools.name: decision.trace
tools.title: Trace decision lineage
